payload.title: Investigating interhemispheric precipitation changes over the past millennium
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook explores interhemispheric precipitation changes over the past millennium by comparing paleoclimate model outputs with proxy observations. It employs Empirical Orthogonal Function (EOF) analysis to identify large-scale spatio-temporal patterns. The notebook utilizes various datasets, including the CESM Last Millennium Ensemble, and performs PCA analysis on both model and proxy data. The results are visualized through scree plots and EOF maps, facilitating a comprehensive model-data comparison.
goals: Compare paleoclimate model output with proxy observations.
Identify large-scale spatio-temporal patterns using EOF analysis.
Perform PCA analysis on gridded and point datasets.
Facilitate model-data comparison in the paleoclimate domain.
